prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. G07-B revision. MATERIAL-ONLY EDIT of the supplied first image. Keep the camera, orthographic projection, EVERY structural outline and EVERY pile center at its current image position. Do not redesign or rearrange this foundation. Produce one 3:2 landscape image, warm white background. Accept the tall narrow object and large white side margins: these are required by true scale. Do NOT widen or shorten the model to fill the landscape.
The first reference is an exact meter-scaled original rendering. Eight pile shafts are already present and individually visible: four slightly lighter foreground cylinders alternate in the image with four slightly darker background cylinders. Preserve all EIGHT, neither merge neighboring cylinders nor remove the darker back row. Preserve their width, length, relative offset and contacts pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. The second reference top plan confirms the same TWO rows of FOUR, not one row of eight. Do not add the plan as a panel.
Apply only restrained matte light grey concrete texture, subtle smooth cylindrical highlights and gentle ambient shadows to make this exact model look like a beautiful physical classroom exhibit. Keep the foreground and rear row slightly different grey shade solely to clarify occlusion, not a force or stress visualization. Keep the pale three-layer soil remnant behind and the thin soil bed below, as drawn, do not add soil in front to cover pile shafts. Cap and pier also stay exactly where drawn.
Geometry constraints for cross-checking only, never print them: cap8 x6 x2m with topz-1 bottomz-3. Central pier2 x2.5m extends fromz-1 toz8. Eight diameter1m piles length20m at x[-2.7,-.9,.9,2.7] in each of y[-1.8,1.8], topsz-3 meet cap and tipsz-23 meet bottom soil. Piles are TWENTY diameters long and TEN cap thicknesses; the pier is9m tall. Preserve the tall slender silhouette. Ground isz0. This is a cutaway teaching model, not a real excavation or geotechnical result.
Do not invent piles or change geometry to make the image prettier. No additional perspective, no zoom crop, no composition restructuring, no shortening, no thickening. No people, tools, machines, rebar, arrows, text, letters, numerals, labels, scales, diagrams, stress clouds, symbols, logos or watermarks.

dimensions_contract.model_status: teaching pile-group cutaway, not a named real foundation
dimensions_contract.soil_note: schematic layers for contact context only, no measured geology, strength, side/end load share or stresses

checks.item: 四根前排与四根后排桩可分别追踪
各桩头与承台相接，所见桩端与土床相接
保持较窄承台、明显细长桩与高墩柱整体关系
所有桩径、间距和20m/1m尺寸像素精确保持
画面无文字、箭头、数值及假云图

observations: 修订底稿采用12°俯角、-76°方位正交视图；两排各四桩在画面上交错，可分别追踪八根至承台及土床。
桩身较首次生成明显细长，且没有用大块土体遮盖后排。
浅灰前排与深灰后排仅是材质及遮挡区分，不能作为受力颜色解释。
生成图相较精确底稿仍有一定桩径视觉加粗，因此不能宣称成图逐像素符合米制尺寸。
limitations: 只通过可见构件数量和连接关系复核，未经几何反求/相机标定，不是CAD或按比例施工图。
需要教授8×6×2m承台、20m桩长、1m桩径或2×4布置时，应与精确底稿及平面图并列；数值以合同/参数图为准。
地层与材质均为教学假设，未计算桩侧和桩端分担。

file_checks.note: File integrity and format checks only; geometric/visual review is recorded separately.

scale_status: 外观关系已复看；精确尺寸以参数底稿为准
